# Listy Gifty

> Gift logistics made simple. Capture ideas, coordinate exchanges, track budgets, and remember every deadline.

Listy Gifty is a web and mobile application for keeping the gift side of life organized across families, friend groups, and teams. It helps people capture ideas year-round, coordinate recipients and gift exchanges, manage budgets, and track gifts from idea to purchase to delivery.

## Key Features

- **Gift Tracking**: Keep track of gift ideas for all the people in your life
- **Budget Management**: Set and track budgets for different occasions and recipients
- **Occasion Reminders**: Never miss a birthday, holiday, or special event
- **Gift Status Tracking**: Track whether gifts are ideas, purchased, wrapped, or given
- **Gift Exchanges**: Run Secret Santa, Yankee Swap, and other draw-name exchanges without spreadsheets
- **Team Gift Workflows**: Plan onboarding kits, holiday boxes, milestone gifts, and client gifts with shared owners
- **MCP Integrations**: Connect compatible assistants to query, create, and update gift data with scoped OAuth access

## Getting Started

Visit [listygifty.com](https://listygifty.com) to create a free account and start planning gifts today.
